description: Hi! We're a team of 4 from Egypt passionate about space, nutrition and making science fun for kids. We're building AstroNutri, a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer game where players run a lunar outpost and balance food, power, water & radiation shielding through nutrition decisions across 4 mission phases. We have a strong science and tech core and we're open to meeting motivated teammates who love games, design, storytelling and space exploration. Let's build something impactful together!
